study.question: After exact target/category/brand feedback counts partially recover auxiliary quality under blocked item gradients, does preserving the associated event content in task-conditioned compressed moments add information beyond those identical counts at modest measured cost?
study.hypothesis: The current union-feedback pooled vector and count-only sidecar lose the association between each historical feedback type, exact target-field relation and the other event fields. For each of all exposures/cart/fav/buy, compress category-match, brand-match and joint-match events into count-normalized item/action means (12 moments total). A small auxiliary residual readout combining the exposure and corresponding-task moments with the target and exact counts can exploit complementary content while auxiliary gradients into shared item/action embeddings remain blocked. Aligned versus count-preserving rotated membership isolates conditional content beyond cardinality; crossing item-gradient permission tests whether representation specialization remains necessary. Click can still change indirectly through auxiliary gradients into shared context. This is a prospective explanation, not established mechanism or originality.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 primary text lines 75-85 describes target-conditioned local activation. Retain the locally adapted scorer and towers; add explicit task/field-conditioned content moments outside that pooled representation. Not a new target-attention claim.

Original arXiv:2508.11565v1 section 3.1 (PDF page 3, Eq. 5) pools projected behavior-specific sequences as proxies, then alternates cross-type attention and within-type processing. We use fixed exact target-field joins and explicit counts, a single compression/readout, and source-path gradient gates; no iterative proxy broadcast. Primary method sections were read via its registry-authorized URL; no local equivalence or priority claim.

Pinned source lines 123-170 initializes task-specific action-masked average hubs and retains raw sequence tokens for iterative exchange. Here supplied task masks intersect exact nonzero target category/brand joins before averaging, alongside the incumbent UF path, without new ID tables or attention hubs.

Pinned forward lines 129-187 splits recent/earlier histories and uses query tokenization/mixing. Our new branch compresses all authorized 100 events by task and exact field relation without time/query mixers; the original HeMix paper is not audited.

Only author README is available and read: its behavior fields omit item IDs. Current histories contain previous advertisement IDs and the auxiliary labels are category/brand-linked future actions. Full DMR mechanisms remain unaudited; no detailed distinction or novelty assertion is made.

inherited_components: Frozen 100-event official_offline input visibility, four outputs, full validation scorer, scratch seed and single-pass host training recipe.
g2-r0004-context_only adapted DIN action-aware scorer, 10 uniform plus 20 union-feedback summaries, four towers, scorer stop-gradient with cloned Dice buffers, open context gradients.
g2-r0006-exact_blocked 40 exact-join count features and three zero-final auxiliary count heads, unchanged including parameter initialization.
Standard masked means, target-times-history feature interactions and task-specific readouts are inherited ideas, not originality claims.
study.proposed_difference: Extend the exact-count ancestor, not the incumbent directly, with 12 count-normalized content means: 4 overlapping historical groups (all valid exposures and the supplied cart/fav/buy masks) x 3 exact relations (nonzero category, nonzero brand, both). Each auxiliary head sees the six means for all exposures and its own historical task, their key-wise products with the target, the target itself and the same 40 exact counts. Add a zero-final 1384->32->1 residual head per auxiliary task for six item fields at width16. A matched control circularly moves the complete joint memberships by half the number of valid events within each example, preserving all counts, overlaps and supplied information while changing which values enter the means. Both cells compute gathers, reductions and heads of the same shape; aligned also zeroes the shift, so tiny control-flow overhead is not exactly identical. Cross aligned/rotated with item/action gradient blocked/shared; no new click head, private ID bank, custom loss, or host recipe change.
predictions: At each fixed item-gradient gate, aligned membership improves auxiliary mean AUC over rotated membership with all three exact count heads identical; per-task AUC/Logloss are mandatory, not replaced by four-task mean. A gain over the count-only ancestor alone is insufficient for the content mechanism.

Blocked aligned content recovers some of the remaining auxiliary gap to g2-r0006-exact_shared while preserving click AUC near the blocked count ancestor (0.660439) and incumbent (0.660647). Prospective practical click tolerance is -0.0003 relative to the count ancestor, descriptive until paired-seed confirmation. Selection remains click AUC exclusively.

Positive alignment effects should concentrate in nonempty join groups; empty histories have exactly zero moment vectors. Historical feedback groups may be sparse and overlap. Slice definitions are predeclared, but host capability to emit added slices is not assumed.

No extra embeddings; expected added dense parameters=133059 with six item fields. Measured training/inference overhead should be below 1.5x the corresponding exact-count ancestor; the suite tests this prediction rather than asserting equal compute. Any promising direction needs paired seeds and user-cluster uncertainty before repeated support.
falsifiers: If aligned does not beat rotated at either fixed gradient gate on auxiliary mean AUC, the claimed conditional content benefit is unsupported at this implementation/recipe; improvement over count-only alone can be readout capacity.

If blocked aligned fails the predeclared click retention tolerance or does not improve auxiliary quality over g2-r0006-exact_blocked, it is not a demonstrated quality tradeoff improvement even if some alignment contrast is positive.
If all gains require auxiliary item-gradient sharing and click falls toward g2-r0006-exact_shared, compressed content has not solved the observed interference tradeoff.

If runtime, throughput or memory erases the advantage over the 435-second private-residual trajectory, the proposed efficiency explanation is unsupported. Any masking, count-preservation, initialization or ownership violation invalidates the contrast before training.
alternative_explanations: Additional dense nonlinear capacity, duplicate count inputs or target-only features can improve both aligned/rotated variants; the matched rotation contrast isolates alignment, not the ancestor comparison alone.

A deterministic cyclic rotation is not independent randomization: similar items can be temporally clustered, short histories may barely change, and singleton histories cannot change. A null is conservative and cannot refute all relational compression. It also changes which actions/recencies accompany join memberships, so a positive supports the joint association rather than one field or feedback type individually.

Shared context updates couple click training to every auxiliary residual even with item gradients blocked; no guarantee of unchanged click optimization. Computational path gates require host alias auditing before claiming parameter ownership.

One seed, rare positives, a single pass, zero-final initialization and the frozen dense learning rate can obscure the value of dense adapters. Replayed same-seed endpoints are consistency checks, not independent support.

Exact matches can exploit the inherited auxiliary-label construction and official offline feedback visibility; any gain is scoped to this benchmark, not advertisement-level conversion attribution or production timing.
The new moments discard within-group temporal order and nonmatching content. Their presence is not proof that they are sufficient statistics.

trajectory_review.evidence_scope: Committed own-arm validation only; all listed executions succeeded. Negative scientific findings below are not runtime failures. Single frozen seed; no independent paired repetitions yet.

paths.observation: Click AUC .657258 for early category-or-brand split versus .657516 rotated and .657571 uniform10. Generic target-aware compression was not supported.
paths.implication: Do not presume a target-conditioned partition wins. This suite asks the narrower conditional-content question after exact-count evidence and keeps a rotation control.

paths.observation: Feedback action/auxiliary routing click AUC .656060/.655847; respective rotated/uniform controls .656644/.657419.
paths.implication: Explicit feedback structure alone did not solve the bottleneck. Preserve computational and gradient controls instead of interpreting feedback masks as automatic gains.

paths.observation: Blocking scorer and embedding paths raised click AUC to .660041 from open .655824; opening only context reached .660647, but auxiliary AUCs were .664153/.709596/.668801 versus .844643/.864167/.868475 when item gradients were also open.
paths.implication: Observed click/auxiliary interference tradeoff motivates retaining the independent gradient gate; computational path blocking does not imply disjoint parameter ownership.

paths.observation: Private ID residuals recovered auxiliary AUCs .828151/.851593/.848763, but click .660099 was below the .660647 no-residual endpoint; cost grew to 435.126s and 56.322M parameters from about305s and32.060M.
paths.implication: New dense content compression must be compared against this failed click/cost direction, not just against a weak auxiliary score. One expensive implementation does not refute private specialization.

paths.observation: Exact blocked versus support blocked auxiliary AUCs .792597/.792798/.795865 versus .740197/.785768/.741558; exact/shared reached .859298/.874108/.883356 while click fell to .658268. Exact blocked click .660439 remains below incumbent .660647.
paths.implication: Controlled single-seed evidence for target equality statistics, incomplete auxiliary recovery and no new best click. The next question is whether content associated with those SAME statistics is useful; alignment-versus-rotation must establish this rather than another ancestor-only comparison.

trajectory_review.latest_knowledge_reflection: The latest usage file links round6 declared INFNet and DIN use to executed exact/support count variants. Executed source has a count sidecar and inherited UF scorer, not INFNet task hubs. Its outcomes support particular exact-count contrasts, not causal value of the source card. This proposal explicitly implements the behavior-specific content means and records the distinct code intervention. Previous considered/unresolved sources remain provenance, not tested algorithms.

host_prerequisites: Verify all frozen data/source/protocol identities through the existing host gates; raw parquet and acquisition receipts are not exposed in this coding workspace, so no new checksum reproduction is claimed.

Execute finite [B,1] four-task outputs and backward in frozen BF16 for B=1/remainder and ordinary batch, empty/singleton/full histories, arbitrary holes in masks and permuted label order; list and [4,B,100] historical task mask forms must agree.

For new torch tensor code, independently check 12 membership counts and pairwise intersections are preserved by rotation over arbitrary valid positions, aligned mapping is identity, invalid positions contribute zero, category/brand/joint overlaps are intentional and zero IDs never match.

Check moment means against an independent slow masked-event reference including n=0,1,2,99,100; perturb padded IDs/action values and unknown target action to verify invariance. Empty moment groups must be exactly zero and remain finite.

Check original 40 exact count vectors match the exact-count ancestor for identical inputs; test target-field perturbations and shuffled historical task masks only as diagnostic interventions on synthetic/authorized inputs, with their costs charged.

With new zero-final heads, verify train/eval logits/probabilities, inherited initial parameter values, CPU RNG state and persistent Dice buffers match the corresponding g2-r0006 exact ancestor at the same gate. Evaluate finite inputs before claiming algebraic parity.

In a disposable diagnostic copy with new final weights made nonzero, isolate the moment residual and audit gradients: blocked target/history/action paths zero, shared paths active where input support exists; scorer parameters not reached by moments. At the actual all-zero final initialization, upstream moment-input gradients are expected zero. Audit cross-source embedding aliases before stronger ownership claims.

Verify all new moment/count head parameters belong to host dense AdamW, embeddings to host Adagrad; measure actual total/dense/embedding parameters, allocated GPU seconds, peak memory, examples, wall time, batch latency and throughput. No equal-compute conclusion follows from same epochs or parameter matching alone.

analysis_plan.primary: Full-population validation is_click AUC alone selects candidates. Keep incumbent g2-r0004-context_only and exact-count parent as explicit references even if an auxiliary tradeoff looks attractive.
analysis_plan.secondary: Report every task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, and measured cost; aligned minus rotated at each gate and their interaction are the primary mechanism contrasts. A four-task mean is never the selection score.
analysis_plan.slices: Use existing host history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 with sample/positive/negative counts and mark insufficient slices. Desired additional predeclared descriptive bins are exact exposure/category-or-brand join count0/1-4/5+ and own-feedback join count0/1/2+; emit them only if host authorizes/can compute them, otherwise mark unavailable rather than altering the scorer. Empty histories have no conditional moment signal. No raw samples or holdout feedback requested.
